summary: HomeStream is a TypeScript ESM pnpm monorepo for LAN media playback. Its implemented Fastify 5 server on Node 24 owns SQLite, TMDB metadata, gateway discovery, NVENC transcoding, source proxy caching, TorBox tracking, health and optional telemetry. The React 19/Vite web app remains a placeholder; desktop and TV are planned. Shared Zod contracts, analytics, flags and sanitization live in packages/shared.
architecture: index.ts loads config/logging, builds app, recovers orphaned encoders, starts loopback proxy and LAN listener, starts health/download workers, and advertises mDNS. app.ts composes services and closes owned resources. Playback resolves ranked sources, probes through proxy, decides output from device capabilities, starts ffmpeg, and serves HLS. Downloads return 202 rather than an active session. Progress/history/home use SQLite and metadata.
patterns: Strict NodeNext TS with .js specifiers and type-only imports. Thin routes validate shared Zod schemas; AppError returns redacted error envelopes with hints. Pure rules have offline unit tests; Fastify inject integration tests use fakes. GPU/live tiers are opt-in. Resource ownership and shutdown are explicit. Hot paths must not regress. Telemetry is optional and allowlisted. No accounts; devices are not authentication; LAN only; always re-encode video; clients send streamId auto.
